audit.why: Difficulty 6/10 and EVEN match the 53.52% win rate over 497 games. Lane is decided by Mini kiting vs Ryze's Flux-root setup; side lane and teamfight framing (Mega engage, peel) is already present.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart contradicted the packet chart and its own whys: sides read Skill/Gnar/Gnar/Skill/Skill/Gnar/Gnar while the packet reads Gnar for Levels 1 through First item and Ryze at 2+ items, and whys[6] plus late/spikes[3] all state Ryze takes over at two items.
audit.why: Spikes themselves are right — Gnar level 2 (Hyper third-hit), Mega windows at 4-5 and 6, Stridebreaker, then Ryze's Tear/Archangel's turn at two items — but the chart owners did not match. Flipped as one atomic group.
audit.corrected: win[0..5] and phases[0..5].side = Gnar; win[6] and phases[6].side = Ryze, with phases[6].why rewritten to state the flip.

audit.whatIsWrong: The pages repeatedly call Rune Prison (W) a root unconditionally and say the E-W root is 'easy to sidestep'. Riot's text: Rune Prison damages and slows, and only roots if Flux is already on the target; Spell Flux hits a single enemy at 615 range and is not a line skillshot, so it cannot be sidestepped.
audit.why: This inverts the actual counterplay. The lock is conditional on E landing first, and E is beaten by staying outside 615 range, not by dodging. Gnar's Mini kite pattern exists precisely to hold that distance.
audit.corrected: Rune Prison (W, 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s) roots only through Spell Flux (E, 3.5s at rank 1, 615 range); with no Flux on you it is only a slow. Ryze has no dash or blink — Realm Warp is a delayed group portal, not an escape — so Mega Wallop and a GNAR! wall-stun land unless he Flashes. Gnar's Hop (E) is 22s at rank 1 and is his only escape.

audit.why: Trading around Rune Prison's cooldown is the right axis; added the real 11s number so the advice is concrete.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing stated the Flux prerequisite for the root, which is the single hidden mechanic of the matchup.
audit.why: Players eat what they think is an unavoidable root and stop trading entirely.
audit.corrected: Folded into the early paragraph and dosFull[0].d.

edits.after: Two items in, his Tear-Archangel's Q resets and Flux-root chains out-range Mini — stop dueling him and engage only with your team.

edits.before: You kite him with Boomerang's slow and Hyper's third-hit move speed; his E-W root is his only stick and it's easy to sidestep in lane.
edits.after: You kite with Boomerang's slow and Hyper's third-hit move speed; Spell Flux is targeted at 615 range, so beat the root with distance, not dodging.

edits.before: Mini Gnar owns these levels — your ranged autos plus a single Boomerang (Q) out-trade Ryze's Overload (Q) before he has the levels to chain E into a long W root. At level 2 your W Hyper third-hit proc is a huge free chunk; hit it plus a Boomerang and shove him under tower. The thing to respect is his E-W: if his Spell Flux (E) lands and he follows with Rune Prison (W), you eat an extended root in your squishy Mini body, so weave your autos and don't stand still in his Q line. Keep poking from max range and last-hit with the tip of Boomerang.
edits.after: Mini Gnar owns these levels — your ranged autos plus a single Boomerang (Q) out-trade Ryze's Overload (Q) before his mana supports chaining. Respect the order: Rune Prison (W) only roots if Spell Flux (E) is already on you, and with no Flux it is just a slow. Flux is targeted at 615 range, so you beat it by standing outside that, not by dodging. At level 2 your W Hyper third-hit proc plus a Boomerang is a free chunk — take it while his W sits on its 11-second cooldown, then last-hit at Boomerang's tip.

edits.before: His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Rune Prison roots only through Flux — no Flux, just a slow. Fight it on its 11s cooldown.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Hop is your only escape and it is down 22 seconds at rank 1 — keep it.

notes: Ryze's Spell Flux is single-target within 615 range per Riot's text; the kit's 'projectile' flag on E is a tooltip-parsing misfire and was not used.
